M2.L1.title: Find and describe flat triangles, squares, rectangles, hexagons, and circles using informal language without naming them.

M2.L2.title: Explain decisions about classifications of triangles into categories using variants and non-examples and record on a picture graph.

M2.L3.title: Explain decisions about classifications of rectangles into categories using variants and non-examples and record on a picture graph. Identify shapes as rectangles.

M2.L4.title: Explain decisions about classifications of hexagons and circles identify them by name, and record on a picture graph. Make observations using variants and non-examples.

M2.L5.title: Describe and communicate positions of all flat shapes using the words above, below, beside, in front of, next to , and behind .

M2.L6.title: Find and describe solid shapes using informal language without naming them.

M2.L7.title: Explain decisions about classification of solid shapes into categories and record on a picture graph. Name the solid shapes.

M2.L8.title: Describe and communicate positions of all solid shapes using the words above, below, beside, in front of, next to , and behind .

M2.L9.title: Identify and sort shapes as two-dimensional or three- dimensional, and recognize two-dimensional and three- dimensional shapes in different orientations and sizes.
